Product Details: Mother's Treasure Chatpata Karonda Achar | Tangy Indian Pickle, Traditional Spices, With Green Chillies, Mustard Oil Based, Pairs with Flatbreads - Distributed/Packaged by Mother'S Treasure. Product Details: Mother's Treasure Chatpata Karonda Achar is a classic Indian pickle that brings together the bold tang of fresh karonda with a rich medley of aromatic spices. Crafted by RRSJM Food Products LLP, this 500 gm jar is packed with fresh karonda pieces coated in mustard oil and a carefully blended mix of fennel, turmeric powder, yellow mustard, red chilli powder, carom seeds, cumin powder, cinnamon powder, black pepper powder, and asafoetida. The result is a chatpata (tangy and spicy) flavour that perfectly complements dal, rice, parathas, and a variety of Indian meals. Made with 64.57% karonda content, this pickle delivers an authentic homestyle taste reminiscent of traditional recipes passed down through generations. The product is FSSAI certified, ensuring it meets food safety standards. With 50 servings per pack, this generously sized jar is ideal for families who love a bold, flavourful condiment on their dining table every day. Store in a cool, dry place and use a dry spoon to maintain freshness.
